description: Use this when the user wants a family list checked before drawing a genogram, for example "check my genogram data for mistakes" or "which generation is each person in". Takes the same people, relations and household as make_genogram. Returns the problems found (unknown or duplicate ids, a person who is their own ancestor with the cycle named, more than 2 biological parents, a parent who is not older than the child, couple years outside a partner's life, twins with different parents, too many generations; above 150 people it checks the first 150 and names the people left out), warnings, and each person's generation number when the data is consistent. Draws nothing and makes no files. Relationships only: it does not take health or medical details.

household.description: Ids of the people who live together; drawn with a dashed outline, e.g. ["p2","p3"].

death_year.description: 4-digit death year, e.g. 2019. Marks the person as deceased.

deceased.description: true draws an X through the symbol when the death year is not known.

id.description: Short unique id, up to 40 characters, used in relations, e.g. "p1" or "maria".

index.description: true for the index person (the person the genogram is about); drawn with a double line. At most one.

name.description: Name shown under the symbol, up to 60 characters, e.g. "Maria Kowalska".

sex.description: M (square), F (circle), X (diamond) or unknown (diamond with ?). Default unknown.

relations.description: The relationships, up to 600 (at most 150 couples and 100 emotional). Example: [{"type":"couple","a":"p1","b":"p2","kind":"married","start_year":1975},{"type":"parent_child","a":"p1","b":"p3"},{"type":"parent_child","a":"p2","b":"p3"}].

a.description: Person id. For parent_child this is the parent, e.g. "p1".

b.description: Person id. For parent_child this is the child, e.g. "p3".

end_year.description: Year a couple divorced, separated or ended, e.g. 1995.

kind.description: couple: married (default), divorced, separated, cohabiting, engaged. parent_child: biological (default), adopted, foster. twins: identical, fraternal (default). emotional: close (default), distant, conflict, cut_off, hostile.

start_year.description: Year a couple married or began, e.g. 1981.

type.description: couple, parent_child (a is the parent, b the child), twins, or emotional.

name: check_genogram
title: Check genogram data
